name.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
name.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

caption.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures.

equation_note.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
equation_note.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

name.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
name.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

note.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
note.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

title.ja: 分布Bratu係数の独立dense感度と行列不要VJP
title.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients

assumptions.ja: 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。
assumptions.en: A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values.

note.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

reference_note.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
reference_note.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

method_note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.
